title: Paradise Lost
description: John Milton's 1667 epic in blank verse retelling the fall of Lucifer, the temptation in Eden, and humanity's expulsion. The single most influential post-biblical literary engagement with Lucifer in Western tradition; Milton's charismatic, sympathetic Lucifer shaped all subsequent Romantic engagement. The corpus reads it as the literary antecedent of the figure's moral rehabilitation.
